BiblicalUsage: Mekownah is the base, the pedestal on which the temple's lavers stood. 1 Kings 7:27 describes the ten bases of brass Solomon made for the temple, and 2 Chronicles 4:14 says the lavers were made upon the bases.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it as a plain reminder: holy things stand on something solid, and God gave the pattern for the base as well as the vessel.
